description: Porky's Meat Market was founded in Windhoek, Namibia, with a vision to provide premium quality meat products to the local community.
Expanded operations to include wholesale distribution, serving restaurants and hotels across Windhoek.
Opened our state-of-the-art cold storage facility, ensuring the highest quality standards for meat preservation.
Launched B2B portal for wholesale buyers, streamlining the ordering process for businesses.
Introduced our digital platform, making premium meat products accessible to retail customers, B2B buyers, and hawker vendors online.
